title: HTTP Cloud Functions on Google Cloud with Node.js
title_es: Cloud Functions HTTP en Google Cloud con Node.js
description: Runnable companion for the GCP Cloud Functions recipe: Express API on Functions Framework Gen 2, Firestore CRUD, Secret Manager caching, CORS, error handling, local dev setup and gcloud deploy scripts including a real Cloud Scheduler cron job.
description_es: Proyecto ejecutable complementario de la receta de Cloud Functions en GCP: API Express sobre Functions Framework Gen 2, CRUD con Firestore, cacheo de Secret Manager, CORS, manejo de errores, ejecución local y scripts de despliegue con gcloud incluido un job real de Cloud Scheduler.
